summary: Completed testing of Content-Level Featured Images feature. All 9 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing verified: Create Content dialog has featured image upload area, Content Detail page displays featured images, Edit mode shows Replace/Remove buttons for existing images.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/content/{id}/featured-image endpoint correctly uploads and stores images in /app/backend/uploads/featured_images/
DELETE /api/content/{id}/featured-image endpoint correctly removes image from storage and database
Featured image persists after content updates (title, body, status changes)
Invalid file types (non-images) are correctly rejected with 400 status
CreateContentDialog.js includes featured image upload area with proper validation (5MB max, JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP)
ContentDetailPage.js displays featured image in view mode and provides Replace/Remove buttons in edit mode
Image preview shows filename and file size in both create dialog and edit mode
seed_data_creation: Test content items created during backend testing with prefix 'TEST_' - automatically cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Content-level featured images fully tested and working. Backend endpoints: POST/DELETE /api/content/{id}/featured-image. Frontend: CreateContentDialog.js has upload area, ContentDetailPage.js shows image in view mode with Replace/Remove in edit mode. Images stored in /app/backend/uploads/featured_images/. WordPress REST API integration remains MOCKED.

upload_featured_image_when_creating_cont.details: CreateContentDialog.js includes 'Featured Image (optional)' section with upload area. Shows 'Click to upload featured image' text and 'JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP • Max 5MB' hint.

view_featured_image_in_content_detail.details: ContentDetailPage.js displays featured image in view mode with 'FEATURED IMAGE' label and filename. Image is rendered with proper styling.

edit_replace_featured_image.details: Edit mode shows 'Replace' button next to existing featured image. Backend correctly handles replacement by deleting old file and storing new one.

remove_featured_image.details: Edit mode shows 'Remove' button (red text) next to existing featured image. DELETE endpoint removes file from storage and sets featured_image to null.

featured_image_persists_after_saving.details: Backend test verified that updating content (title, body, status) does not affect the featured_image field. Image persists correctly.
